title.en: A guarded evolution layer for OpenClaw hosts
title.zh: OpenClaw 主機的守護型演化層

description.en: Adds a Hermes study agent, a guardian subagent, a chattr-frozen policy baseline, and a cross-patrol heartbeat to an existing OpenClaw host. Hermes only drafts changes; high-risk ones wait for the operator.
description.zh: 在既有的 OpenClaw 主機上加裝負責研究的 Hermes agent、看顧它的 subagent、以 chattr 凍結的政策基線，以及交叉巡邏心跳。Hermes 只能起草變更，高風險的變更要等管理者核准。

headline.en: Let the agent study. Keep the keys.
headline.zh: 讓 agent 去研究，鑰匙留在你手上。

lede.en: A drop-in layer for an existing OpenClaw host. Hermes studies what should improve, a maintainer watches Hermes, plain Bash watches both, and high-risk changes still wait for you.
lede.zh: 裝在既有 OpenClaw 主機上的一層。Hermes 研究哪裡該改進，維護用的 subagent 看著 Hermes，單純的 Bash 再看著兩者，高風險的變更仍然要等你點頭。

notes.en: No edits to OpenClaw or Hermes code
notes.zh: 不修改 OpenClaw 與 Hermes 的程式碼

meta.en: Default schedules · stale after interval + grace
meta.zh: 預設排程 · 超過週期加寬限才算逾時

label.zh: 最新版本，2026 年 5 月
具心跳監測的排程工作

label.en: Edits to OpenClaw or Hermes code
label.zh: 對 OpenClaw、Hermes 程式碼的修改

title.en: Long-running agents drift, or they overreach.
title.zh: 長期運作的 agent，不是漂移，就是越權。

body.en: A daily upstream-diff cron turns into alert fatigue. An ad-hoc agent session starts cold every time. An agent that updates itself can also rewrite the alarm meant to catch it. This layer separates learning, operating, watching, and approving.
body.zh: 每天比對上游的 cron，最後變成警報疲勞。臨時開的 agent session 每次都從零開始。能自我更新的 agent，也可能改掉原本要抓它的警報。這一層把學習、執行、監看與核准拆開。

quote.en: The first thing a misaligned agent learns to do is silence the alert that would have caught it.
quote.zh: 偏離目標的 agent，最先學會的往往是讓那個會抓到它的警報安靜下來。

intro.en: Install once on a host that already runs OpenClaw. After that, the system works quietly and leaves its findings in files.
intro.zh: 在已經跑著 OpenClaw 的主機上安裝一次。之後系統安靜運作，把發現留在檔案裡。

body.en: Render templates, freeze the baseline, install Hermes if it is missing, add one profile, register the maintainer, and schedule five jobs. Every step is safe to re-run.
body.zh: 渲染範本、凍結基線、需要時安裝 Hermes、新增一個 profile、註冊維護用的 subagent，再排好五個排程。每一步都可以重複執行。

body.en: Monday reads a service log; later days cover upstream commits, community skills and plugins, drafting, and pack review. Saturday prunes memory, Sunday is off. The prompt caps each run at 30 minutes or 30 turns.
body.zh: 週一讀服務日誌，接下來幾天依序看上游 commit、社群 skill 與 plugin，起草 pack，再檢查 pack 是否就緒。週六整理記憶，週日休息。prompt 要求每次不超過 30 分鐘或 30 輪。

body.en: Each evolution pack declares its kind, target services, evidence, and a rollback command. Hermes can draft one. It cannot apply one.
body.zh: 每個 evolution pack 都寫明類型、影響的服務、證據與回滾指令。Hermes 可以起草，但不能套用。

body.en: Healthy operation is silent. Read the journal, review the packs that need you, and hear from Telegram only when a job misses its window.
body.zh: 正常運作時完全安靜。讀 journal、審查需要你決定的 pack，只有排程錯過時間窗時，Telegram 才會通知你。

title.en: Oversight that does not depend on trust.

intro.en: The parts that must never be talked out of their job are plain code. The parts that need judgment are agents, and Hermes, the one that studies, can only propose.
intro.zh: 絕對不能被說服放棄職責的部分，用單純的程式；需要判斷的部分交給 agent，而負責研究的 Hermes 只能提案。

body.en: Policy, permission, and mission files, plus the watcher script, are deployed with chattr +i. Changing them takes sudo chattr -i first, and the watcher logs any file that loses the flag.
body.zh: 政策、權限、任務檔與 watcher 腳本都以 chattr +i 部署。要修改就得先 sudo chattr -i，任何檔案失去不可變屬性，watcher 都會記下來。

body.en: A small Bash loop under a systemd user unit checks the immutable flag, SHA-256 hashes, and the gateway process every 60 seconds, and logs anomalies to the journal. It is code, not a model.
body.zh: 一支由 systemd user unit 管理的小型 Bash 迴圈，每 60 秒檢查不可變屬性、SHA-256 雜湊與 gateway 程序，異常就寫進 journal。它是程式，不是模型。

body.en: Every scheduled job writes its heartbeat before its real task, then checks the other four. A missed run shows up in the next peer's patrol; healthy runs send nothing.
body.zh: 每個排程工作先寫心跳再做正事，接著檢查另外四個工作。有工作漏跑，下一個執行的工作巡邏時就會發現；正常執行時什麼都不發。

body.en: The hermes-maintainer subagent runs doctor checks, upstream watch, a weekly review, and monthly compaction. It reports. It cannot upgrade Hermes.
body.zh: hermes-maintainer 這個 subagent 負責 doctor 檢查、上游追蹤、每週回顧與每月壓縮。它只回報，不能自行升級 Hermes。

body.en: Five pack kinds, from skill installs to config changes. Skill, plugin, and upstream-patch packs can apply inside a weekly change budget; custom work and config changes wait for review. Each one carries evidence and a rollback.
body.zh: 五種 pack 類型，從安裝 skill 到修改設定。skill、plugin 與上游 patch 可以在每週變更額度內套用；自行設計的變更與設定修改要等審查。每個 pack 都附上證據與回滾方式。

body.en: Everything this layer writes (journal, notes, packs, heartbeats) is plain JSONL, Markdown, YAML, or one-line text. A future operator, or a rescue session, can read it with cat.
body.zh: 這一層寫下的所有東西（journal、筆記、pack、心跳）都是純 JSONL、Markdown、YAML 或單行文字。未來的管理者或救援 session，用 cat 就讀得懂。

intro.en: The agents do not negotiate over a hidden live channel. They exchange files the operator can inspect, and deterministic code guards the cognitive parts.
intro.zh: Agent 之間不透過隱藏的即時通道協商，而是交換管理者看得到的檔案。認知型的部分，由確定性的程式看守。

label.zh: 起草 → 標記 → 驗證 → 核准

lines.zh: 把 pack 轉給主 agent

items.en: Never edits OpenClaw or Hermes installed code
items.zh: 絕不修改 OpenClaw 或 Hermes 已安裝的程式碼

items.en: Integrates only through public CLIs and documented paths
items.zh: 只透過公開 CLI 與文件記載的路徑整合

items.en: openclaw upgrade and hermes update keep working
items.zh: openclaw upgrade 與 hermes update 照常運作

items.en: Bot tokens live in a separate, gitignored secrets file
items.zh: Bot token 放在獨立且不進 git 的 secrets 檔
正常運作時不發任何訊息

title.en: Why it is shaped this way.

body.en: Forking OpenClaw or Hermes would mean owning their upgrades forever. Staying on public CLIs lets upstream releases flow through, and keeps this repository small.
body.zh: fork OpenClaw 或 Hermes，等於永遠要自己扛升級。只走公開 CLI，上游版本可以直接流進來，這個 repo 也能維持精簡。

title.en: Bash for the guard, a model for the thinking
title.zh: 看守用 Bash，思考交給模型

body.en: Anything that must never be argued out of its job is plain Bash under systemd. Models are used where judgment helps, never as the last line of defense.
body.zh: 任何不能被說服放棄職責的東西，都是 systemd 管理的純 Bash。模型只用在需要判斷的地方，絕不當最後一道防線。

body.en: Approval fatigue quietly kills oversight. The heartbeat design alerts only when a job actually misses its window, so every message deserves a look.
body.zh: 審批疲勞會悄悄讓監督失效。心跳設計只在排程真的錯過時間窗時才通知，所以每一則訊息都值得看。

title.en: Five commands on an existing host.

intro.en: You need a Linux host where OpenClaw already runs, an authenticated gh CLI, sudo for chattr, and bash 4+, jq, curl, envsubst, and systemd user services with linger enabled. Telegram is optional.
intro.zh: 你需要一台已經在跑 OpenClaw 的 Linux 主機、登入好的 gh CLI、可以執行 chattr 的 sudo 權限，以及 bash 4+、jq、curl、envsubst，還有開啟 linger 的 systemd user service。Telegram 可有可無。

body.en: machine.env holds non-secret settings. For Telegram, also copy machine.env.secrets.example to machine.env.secrets and put the bot tokens there; that file stays out of git.
body.zh: machine.env 放非機密設定。要用 Telegram 的話，再把 machine.env.secrets.example 複製成 machine.env.secrets，bot token 放在那裡，這個檔案不進 git。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/teddashh/openclaw-hermes-watcher
cd openclaw-hermes-watcher
cp config/machine.env.example config/machine.env
$EDITOR config/machine.env

body.en: Steps 00 to 11 run in order and are safe to re-run. It asks for sudo to set chattr, and the first Hermes install takes 10 to 20 minutes.
body.zh: 依序執行 00 到 11 步，可以放心重跑。設定 chattr 時會要求 sudo，第一次安裝 Hermes 約需 10 到 20 分鐘。

body.en: all.sh already runs the smoke test once. Re-run it any time: 41 checks, non-zero exit on any failure.
body.zh: all.sh 已經跑過一次冒煙測試，之後隨時可以重跑：共 41 項檢查，只要有一項失敗就以非零狀態結束。

intro.en: A template extracted from a working deployment and migration-tested on a real host since v0.1.4. No feature changes since May 2026; an October 2026 cleanup fixed docs, template wording, the CI render check, and an install summary that printed the patrol bot token.
intro.zh: 從實際運作的部署抽出來的範本，v0.1.4 起在真實主機上做過遷移測試。2026 年 5 月以後沒有新功能；2026 年 10 月的整理修正了文件、範本用字、CI 的渲染檢查，以及安裝摘要會印出巡邏 bot token 的問題。

works.en: One-command install with scripts/all.sh, re-runnable on an existing host
works.zh: scripts/all.sh 一鍵安裝，可以在既有主機上重跑

works.en: Immutable baseline, 60-second watcher, and five heartbeat-checked jobs
works.zh: 不可變基線、每 60 秒的 watcher，以及五個具心跳檢查的排程工作

works.en: Optional Telegram bots, separate for the maintainer and for Hermes
works.zh: 可選的 Telegram bot，維護用的 subagent 與 Hermes 各自一個
安裝後有 41 項檢查的冒煙測試

works.en: CI runs shell syntax checks, a PII guard, and a template-render smoke test
works.zh: CI 會跑 shell 語法檢查、PII 防護與範本渲染冒煙測試

limits.en: Linux only, and OpenClaw must already be installed and working
limits.zh: 只支援 Linux，而且要先有正常運作的 OpenClaw

limits.en: Agents run as the installing user and the installer leaves sudo alone, so chattr +i holds only if that user needs a password for sudo
limits.zh: agent 和安裝時用的是同一個 Linux 帳號，安裝程式也不會動 sudo 設定；只有這個帳號執行 sudo 需要密碼時，chattr +i 才擋得住 agent

limits.en: 8 of the 11 forbidden actions in the policy, stopping the watcher among them, have no deterministic check yet (marked todo_implement)
limits.zh: 政策列出的 11 項禁止行為，有 8 項還沒有確定性的檢查（標為 todo_implement），停掉 watcher 就是其中之一

limits.en: Config paths were verified against OpenClaw v2026.5.x. On 2026.5.20 or later, talk-helpers on main finds only the two default agents; the fix is in open pull request #1
limits.zh: 設定路徑是以 OpenClaw v2026.5.x 驗證的。2026.5.20 以後，main 分支的 talk-helpers 只找得到兩個預設 agent，修正還在尚未合併的 PR #1

limits.en: The daily-study prompt spells out /home/ubuntu paths, so another Linux user needs a template edit
limits.zh: 每日研究的 prompt 直接寫死 /home/ubuntu 路徑，換成其他 Linux 帳號就得改範本

limits.en: Patrol alerts reach Telegram through an HTTP proxy at 127.0.0.1:8118 by default, and blanking the setting does not turn it off, so a host without that proxy only logs alerts to a file
limits.zh: 巡邏警報預設經過 127.0.0.1:8118 的 HTTP proxy 送到 Telegram，把設定清空也關不掉；主機上沒有這個 proxy 的話，警報只會寫進記錄檔

limits.en: The 30-minute, 30-turn budget is a prompt instruction, not a hard limit, and there are no measured token-cost figures
limits.zh: 30 分鐘、30 輪的預算只是 prompt 裡的指示，不是硬性限制，也沒有實測的 token 用量數字

intro.en: The prompt picks the task from the UTC weekday. Sunday only writes the heartbeat.
intro.zh: prompt 用 UTC 星期決定題目。週日只寫心跳。

note.en: The prompt asks Hermes to check the UTC weekday itself.
note.zh: prompt 請 Hermes 自己看 UTC 是星期幾。

note.en: Monday through Saturday each have their own task, matching those six lanes in order.
note.zh: 週一到週六各一題，順序跟那六條路一樣。

caption.en: The 30 minute and 30 turn cap is only a line in the prompt.
caption.zh: 30 分鐘和 30 輪只是 prompt 裡的一行，腳本不會擋。

intro.en: A small Bash script that systemd runs every minute.
intro.zh: 一支小 Bash 腳本，systemd 每一分鐘叫它跑一次。

note.en: If the script fails, systemd starts it again.
note.zh: 腳本失敗的話，systemd 會再把它叫起來。

note.en: One pass checks that the files are still locked, that the hash list matches, and that the gateway process is up.
note.zh: 一輪要看檔案有沒有鎖著、雜湊清單對不對，還有 gateway 行程在不在。

note.en: Something wrong adds one line to the journal.
note.zh: 有問題就在紀錄裡多寫一列。

caption.en: A clean minute writes nothing, except a heartbeat about once an hour.
caption.zh: 平常什麼都不寫，大約一小時才補一列心跳。

intro.en: Five jobs each write a heartbeat, then look at the other four.
intro.zh: 五個工作先寫自己的心跳，再看另外四個。

note.en: Time, interval, and grace all go into that file.
note.zh: 時間、週期和寬限都寫進那個檔。

note.en: Late starts after the interval plus the grace, and four fresh peers mean it stays quiet.
note.zh: 超過週期加寬限才算晚，四個都還新就繼續安靜。

note.en: An alert goes to a chat when one is set, and otherwise it stays in a local file.
note.zh: 有設好聊天就發過去，沒有的話就留在本機檔案。

caption.en: They watch each other: the daily doctor, the upstream watch, the weekly review, the monthly compress, and the daily study.
caption.zh: 互相看的是這五個：每天的 doctor、上游監視、每週回顧、每月壓縮，還有每天的研究。

intro.en: The main agent counts the weekly budget.
intro.zh: 每週額度是主 agent 在算的。

note.en: Hermes writes a manifest under upgrade-packs/inbox and cannot apply it.
note.zh: Hermes 把清單寫到 upgrade-packs/inbox，自己不能套。

note.en: A week allows 5 low, 2 medium, and 1 high. Only skill, plugin, and upstream patch packs can go in without you.
note.zh: 一週低 5、中 2、高 1。不必等你點頭的，只有 skill、plugin 和上游 patch。

caption.en: Forbidden changes such as hermes update have a budget of 0.
caption.zh: hermes update 這類禁止的變更，額度是 0。

intro.en: Hermes can draft, the guardian can flag, and the watcher only checks files.
intro.zh: Hermes 能起草，守護者能標記，看守程式只檢查檔案。

note.en: The study profile can write a pack, and that is where it stops.
note.zh: 研究用的 profile 寫得出 pack，寫完就停。

note.en: hermes-maintainer can report doctor, upstream, review, and compress, and hermes update stays yours.
note.zh: hermes-maintainer 回報 doctor、上游、回顧和壓縮，hermes update 留在你手上。

note.en: It can look at the frozen files, and it cannot change them.
note.zh: 它看得到鎖住的檔，但改不了。

note.en: sudo and chattr stay with you, along with any custom or config pack.
note.zh: sudo、chattr，還有自訂和設定 pack，都等你點頭。

caption.en: A draft stays a draft until you approve it.
caption.zh: 草稿就只是草稿，要你點頭才算數。

intro.en: Run the installer on a host that already has OpenClaw. Running it again is safe.
intro.zh: 在已經有 OpenClaw 的主機上跑安裝程式。再跑一次也沒關係。

note.en: Non-secret settings go in machine.env, and bot tokens live in a separate file that git ignores.
note.zh: 非機密的設定放 machine.env，bot token 放另一個 git 會忽略的檔。

note.en: Templates get filled in, Hermes is installed when it is missing, and the maintainer is registered.
note.zh: 先把範本填好，沒有 Hermes 才裝，再註冊維護用的 subagent。

note.en: The policy, the permissions, the mission, and the watcher files are locked so they cannot be changed.
note.zh: 政策、權限、任務和看守腳本會鎖上，之後就改不了。

caption.en: The last three checks only warn. A real failure still exits non-zero.
caption.zh: 最後三項只會警告，真的失敗才會以非零結束。
